title: Integral Chow modification with a relatively ample projective-space line bundle
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-integral-scheme], separated and of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. There exist an integer $N\geq0$, an integral separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$, a proper surjective $k$-morphism $\pi:Y\to X$ [def-weil-surjective-morphism], an immersion $j:Y\to\mathbf P^N_k$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and a nonempty open $U\subseteq X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that $\pi^{-1}(U)\to U$ is an isomorphism. The invertible module $\mathcal L=j^*\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^N_k}(1)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pc-projective-space-twist, def-sc-invertible-module] is $\pi$-relatively ample: for every affine open $W\subseteq X$, $\mathcal L|_{\pi^{-1}(W)}$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. No properness hypothesis on $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is made.
